description: Modify an existing bill. Can update vendor, date, due date, memo, and/or lines. For lines: provide line_id to update existing line, omit to add new line, set delete=true to remove. A line_id preserves the line's existing customer unless customer_name/customer_id is given; pass customer_name: "" to clear it. Note: DepartmentRef is header-level only — lines do not support department.

draft.description: If true, validate and show preview without saving (default: true)

due_date.description: New due date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

lines.description: Line modifications. Provide line_id to update existing, omit to add new.

class_id.description: Class ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use class_name)

class_name.description: Class name for this line (e.g., '5614'), auto-resolved to ID. Sets/changes per-line QBO Class tracking. Existing class is preserved if omitted.

customer_id.description: Customer ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use customer_name)

customer_name.description: Customer or project this line is attributed to (auto-resolved to ID). Omit to keep the line's current customer; pass "" to clear it. Bill lines accept a customer only — the vendor is the header vendor_name.

delete.description: Set true to remove this line (requires line_id)

line_id.description: ID of existing line to update (omit for new line)

txn_date.description: New transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

vendor_name.description: New vendor display name (e.g., 'Simplisafe', 'PG&E'). Auto-resolved to ID.

name: edit_bill
